scenes.say: 누구는 별 다섯, 누구는 별 하나를 줘요.

scenes.caption: 같은 순간을 함께 달렸는데
scenes.clipPrompt: Keep the exact flat hand-drawn illustration style, colors and line art. Static camera. In the relay exchange zone on the school field, the baton rolls slowly on the ground.
